expectation: Membrane ring on dendritic cells and some macrophages, a minority of cells, scattered or clustered in HLADR-rich myeloid aggregates; dim or absent on lymphocytes, tumour and stroma.
observed: A: yellow signal is patchy across cores, dense in some cores and sparse in others. B and C: sparse elongated cells, mostly empty. D: a clear membrane ring around a nucleus. E: CD11c cells cluster inside the HLADR-rich aggregate, overlap HLADR (white) and leave HLADR-negative tissue dark.
why: A distinct subset of cells with membrane-ring staining clusters within HLADR-rich myeloid areas and avoids partner-negative tissue.
notes: CD11c shows membrane rings on a subset of cells (D). It clusters in HLADR-rich myeloid aggregates and mostly co-localizes with HLADR (E3), as expected for dendritic cells and macrophages. Sparse B and C fields are expected.
